cues.en: Instructor: I'm going to introduce you to something called a polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 講師：現在介紹多項式迴歸。

cues.en: You'll see that in some sense, it's basically the same thing as the other regressions we've been working with so far, but in another sense, it's a little bit different.
cues.zh: 某種意義上，它與目前使用的其他迴歸基本相同，但另一方面，又有些不同。

cues.en: So we have to work with the data in or with the model in a slightly different way.
cues.zh: 因此，處理資料或模型的方式，需要稍作改變。

cues.en: Okay? And actually, I'm gonna even gonna start by just reminding you of what a polynomial is.
cues.zh: 先提醒一下，多項式是什麼。

cues.en: So a polynomial is basically any expression that looks like this, where we have our data X and then it's taken to increasingly high powers.
cues.zh: 多項式基本上是這樣的式子，有資料 X，再取愈來愈高的次方。

cues.en: And then we have some coefficients that are scaling the data.
cues.zh: 另外有一些係數，縮放資料。

cues.en: So A0 is, it's kind of not multiplying by X, but you could think of this as being multiplied by X to the zero.
cues.zh: A0 沒有乘 X，但可以想成乘上 X 的零次方。

cues.en: And then we have A1 times X to the power of one, A2 times X squared, blah, blah, blah, up to A sub N.
cues.zh: 接著 A1 乘 X 的一次方、A2 乘 X 平方，以此類推，一直到 A 下標 N。

cues.en: So some coefficient, some number AN times X to the nth power, and X is our data.
cues.zh: 某個係數、數字 AN，乘上 X 的 N 次方，X 是資料。

cues.en: Okay? So here are two examples of polynomial expression.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個多項式例子。

cues.en: So you see this would correspond to A0 this would correspond to A1, 5/6 here would correspond to A2 and so on.
cues.zh: 這裡對應 A0，這裡對應 A1，這裡的六分之五對應 A2，依此類推。

cues.en: Now, for a polynomial, you don't need to have every single X term in here.
cues.zh: 多項式不一定要包含每個 X 項。

cues.en: You can just imagine that there, you know, so in this example, a sub two would be equal to zero.
cues.zh: 例如這裡可以想成 A2 等於 0。

cues.en: So you could, you know, think of writing zero times x squared, but in practice that's just left out.
cues.zh: 可以寫成 0 乘 X 平方，但實際上會直接省略。

cues.en: Same thing with with A0 here is also set to zero.
cues.zh: 這裡 A0 也同樣設為 0。

cues.en: So there's another concept in polynomials, which is called the order.
cues.zh: 多項式還有一個概念，稱為階數。

cues.en: So the order of a polynomial is basically N here, it's the highest coefficient.
cues.zh: 階數基本上就是這裡的 N，也就是最高的係數。

cues.en: So this is an nth order polynomial.
cues.zh: 這是 N 階多項式。

cues.en: This is a third order polynomial.
cues.zh: 這是三階多項式。

cues.en: This is also a third order polynomial.
cues.zh: 這也是三階多項式。

cues.en: Sometimes people get confused about this because there's only two terms, but the order of a polynomial doesn't refer to the total number of terms.
cues.zh: 有時會搞混，因為只有兩項，但階數不是指項目的總數。

cues.en: It refers to the largest exponent in any of the terms.
cues.zh: 而是所有項中最大的指數。

cues.en: So third order polynomial.
cues.zh: 所以是三階多項式。

cues.en: Okay, so here's a polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 這裡是多項式迴歸。

cues.en: Technically this looks like the simple regression that you saw several videos ago, but, so you can see this is beta zero times X to the zero,
cues.zh: 技術上，看起來像幾支影片之前的簡單迴歸，beta0 乘 X 的零次方，

cues.en: which earlier I was calling out A zero.
cues.zh: 先前稱為 A0。

cues.en: Now I call it beta zero.
cues.zh: 現在稱為 beta0。

cues.en: And now it's beta one times X to the power of one.
cues.zh: 接著 beta1 乘 X 的一次方。

cues.en: So this simple regression is actually nothing more than a first order polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 所以簡單迴歸，其實就是一階多項式迴歸。

cues.en: Okay? But with polynomial regressions, we can add more terms here.
cues.zh: 但多項式迴歸可以加入更多項。

cues.en: So we can add something like this.
cues.zh: 例如這樣。

cues.en: So we say Y equals beta zero, the intercept plus beta one times x plus beta two times x squared, plus the residual term, and on and on and on.
cues.zh: Y 等於 beta0 截距，加 beta1 乘 X，加 beta2 乘 X 平方，再加殘差項，還能繼續。

cues.en: And so we can get this to be higher order.
cues.zh: 因此可以變成更高階。

cues.en: So let's say beta K times X to the power of K.
cues.zh: 例如 betaK 乘 X 的 K 次方。

cues.en: So this would be a kth order, polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 這就是 K 階多項式迴歸。

cues.en: Now here's a question, how can we fit this kind of model?
cues.zh: 問題是，如何擬合這種模型？

cues.en: Look at these non-linearities, there's non-linear term.
cues.zh: 看看這些非線性項。

cues.en: So you know, these are here, X is linear, but now we're bringing X to higher and higher powers.
cues.zh: 這裡 X 是線性，但接著取愈來愈高的次方。

cues.en: And didn't I say in the beginning of this section that regression is all about a general linear model, so it has to be linear.
cues.zh: 本單元開頭不是說，迴歸屬於一般線性模型，所以必須線性嗎？

cues.en: So how can we fit this polynomial regression if we have these squared terms in here, which are, and yeah, higher order power terms, which are non-linear.
cues.zh: 這裡有平方與更高次方這些非線性項，怎麼能擬合多項式迴歸？

cues.en: Well, you have to remember the other thing I said about what needs to be linear and what can be non-linear.
cues.zh: 必須記得，先前也說過，哪些需要線性，哪些可以非線性。

cues.en: So in fact, the coefficients are all linear.
cues.zh: 係數其實全部都是線性的。

cues.en: The betas are all linear.
cues.zh: beta 都是線性的。

cues.en: They're just being regular multiplied.
cues.zh: 只是一般乘法。

cues.en: There's no squaring happening to the beta.
cues.zh: 沒有把 beta 平方。

cues.en: So in fact, it may not look like it initially, but a polynomial regression is a standard regular run of the mill vanilla plain, general linear model.
cues.zh: 所以雖然乍看不像，多項式迴歸其實就是標準、一般、普通的一般線性模型。

cues.en: And that's because we're not doing anything non-linear with the coefficients.
cues.zh: 因為沒有對係數做任何非線性運算。

cues.en: It's just the data themselves that are getting raised to higher powers.
cues.zh: 只有資料本身被取更高次方。

cues.en: Okay? So here is what, here you see two examples.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個例子。

cues.en: This shows you when you would use a polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 示範什麼時候使用多項式迴歸。

cues.en: So here we have our data looks like this.
cues.zh: 資料像這樣。

cues.en: The blue circles are the data, blue circles are the data.
cues.zh: 藍色圓圈是資料，這邊也是。

cues.en: So you can see that a line is not going to be a really great fit to this dataset.
cues.zh: 一條直線，顯然無法很好擬合這份資料。

cues.en: So this is a second order polynomial.
cues.zh: 這是二階多項式。

cues.en: So that means that this polynomial has the form Y equals at beta one, which is the intercept plus beta two times x,
cues.zh: 形式是 Y 等於 beta1 截距，加 beta2 乘 X，

cues.en: which is a linear term plus beta three.
cues.zh: 這是線性項，再加 beta3。

cues.en: Oh wait, I'm miscounting my betas.
cues.zh: 等一下，beta 編號數錯了。

cues.en: Anyway, beta two would be times x squared.
cues.zh: 總之，beta2 應該是乘 X 平方。

cues.en: And that gives us this quadratic form here.
cues.zh: 這就形成這裡的二次曲線。

cues.en: So this part, we need the x squared in here, the beta coefficient in the x squared in order to get this model to fit.
cues.zh: 需要 X 平方，以及它的 beta 係數，才能讓模型擬合。

cues.en: And this would be a third order polynomial.
cues.zh: 這則是三階多項式。

cues.en: So you'll probably recognize the general form of X cubed in this data set here.
cues.zh: 你應該認得，資料大致呈現 X 三次方的形式。

cues.en: So these would be the kind of data that you would use for a polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 這些就是會用多項式迴歸的資料。

cues.en: Now, of course, that leads to the natural question of what is the appropriate order?
cues.zh: 自然會有一個問題：適當階數是多少？

cues.en: Because when you set up a polynomial regression, you are given, so this x, this is one independent variable I can multiply, I can bring it up
cues.zh: 設定多項式迴歸時，X 是一個自變數，可以乘上，或取

cues.en: to any higher power that I want.
cues.zh: 任何想要的高次方。

cues.en: We could go up to, you know, beta 1000 times X to the power of 1000.
cues.zh: 甚至可以到 beta1000 乘 X 的 1000 次方。

cues.en: I mean, maybe that's a little high to be sensible, but you know, there isn't a real hard limit for how many powers we can include here.
cues.zh: 也許高得不合理，但能納入幾次方，其實沒有明確硬性上限。

cues.en: I suppose you could say that the limit would be when K exceeds the number of data points, because then we can no longer fit the model.
cues.zh: 也許可以說，K 超過資料點數就是上限，因為那時無法擬合模型。

cues.en: But that's only, it turns out to be just a soft constraint.
cues.zh: 但那其實只是軟性限制。

cues.en: So how do we know what order, the polynomial should be?
cues.zh: 如何知道多項式該是幾階？

cues.en: So that's a good question.
cues.zh: 這是好問題。

cues.en: Here you see an example of this dataset that I showed in the previous slide with an order of two.
cues.zh: 這裡是上一張投影片的資料，使用二階。

cues.en: So visually this doesn't look good, right?
cues.zh: 視覺上看起來不好，對吧？

cues.en: I mean, we can, it's trying, you know, the model is trying to fit the data.
cues.zh: 模型有在努力擬合。

cues.en: It gets an A for effort, but you know, it, this is just not a good model.
cues.zh: 努力程度可以給 A，但這真的不是好模型。

cues.en: And here we have increasingly higher orders.
cues.zh: 這裡使用愈來愈高的階數。

cues.en: So here we have a model order of 17.
cues.zh: 這裡模型階數是 17。

cues.en: And I showed this slide actually in towards the beginning of this course.
cues.zh: 這張投影片，其實課程前段展示過。

cues.en: And this is something about overfitting.
cues.zh: 涉及過度擬合。

cues.en: We are overfitting data.
cues.zh: 我們在過度擬合資料。

cues.en: I'm gonna talk more about overfitting in regression modeling soon in several videos from now.
cues.zh: 再過幾支影片，會詳細談迴歸建模的過度擬合。

cues.en: Okay? But so how do we know what is the appropriate order that we should use?
cues.zh: 如何知道適當階數？

cues.en: This is too small, the order is too small.
cues.zh: 這裡階數太小。

cues.en: Here the order is too large.
cues.zh: 這裡太大。

cues.en: We're overfitting, we're capturing too much of noise here.
cues.zh: 過度擬合，捕捉太多雜訊。

cues.en: Okay? So the way that we go about figuring out the appropriate order is through something called the Bayes information criteria.
cues.zh: 我們透過貝氏資訊準則，找出適當階數。

cues.en: It's often just abbreviated as BIC.
cues.zh: 通常縮寫為 BIC。

cues.en: So this is Bayes information criterion.
cues.zh: 就是貝氏資訊準則。

cues.en: And so the idea is that this is a quantity that we can compute for every model order.
cues.zh: 這是每個模型階數，都能計算的一個量。

cues.en: So we get up to K model order, so we can compute k BIC.
cues.zh: 最多到 K 階，就可以計算 K 個 BIC。

cues.en: And this is a formula, so it's N where N is the number of data points that you have times the log, the natural log of the sum of squares of the residuals.
cues.zh: 公式是 N，資料點數，乘上殘差平方和的自然對數。

cues.en: And I showed you the formula for this quantity several videos ago, plus K, which is the number of parameters times the natural log of N.
cues.zh: 這個平方和的公式，幾支影片之前展示過，再加 K，參數數量，乘 N 的自然對數。

cues.en: Okay? So then what you do is you run through a bunch of different model orders and you fit them all.
cues.zh: 接著嘗試一系列不同模型階數，全部擬合。

cues.en: And then you look at a plot of these BICs and that's gonna look something like this.
cues.zh: 再畫出 BIC，會像這樣。

cues.en: So this is the BIC plotted as a function of the polynomial order.
cues.zh: BIC 作為多項式階數的函數。

cues.en: And then what you wanna look for is a minimum point here.
cues.zh: 要找的是這裡的最小點。

cues.en: So the minimum point is the optimal model order.
cues.zh: 最小點就是最佳模型階數。

cues.en: So in this case that would be three, which is actually consistent with these data.
cues.zh: 這個例子是 3，與資料一致。

cues.en: And in fact, I created these data as a third order polynomial plus noise.
cues.zh: 因為資料原本就是三階多項式加雜訊。

cues.en: So it's no surprise that a third order polynomial turns out to be the best fit.
cues.zh: 所以三階多項式是最佳擬合，並不意外。

cues.en: Okay? So that's the base information criteria.
cues.zh: 這就是貝氏資訊準則。

cues.en: You fit the model with a bunch of different order parameters.
cues.zh: 用一系列不同階數參數擬合模型。

cues.en: So you rerun a bunch of regression models and you take the model that has the smallest base information criteria as being the optimal model order.
cues.zh: 重新執行多個迴歸模型，選出貝氏資訊準則最小的模型，作為最佳階數。

cues.en: So in this video I showed you how to interpret and compute and set up a polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 這支影片示範了如何解讀、計算與設定多項式迴歸。
